condition: Low-risk adenomas after polypectomy — no early surveillance
summary: 58-year-old man after a complete, good-quality screening colonoscopy with removal of two tubular adenomas (5 and 7 mm, low-grade dysplasia). BSG 2020: no colonoscopic surveillance (return to screening); US MSTF 2020: repeat in 7–10 years.

inputs.hpi: Screening colonoscopy 3 weeks ago: complete to caecum, Boston bowel preparation score 8. Two polyps removed en bloc by cold snare: 5 mm and 7 mm, both tubular adenomas with low-grade dysplasia, completely excised. Asymptomatic. No family history.

imaging.name: Colonoscopy
imaging.result: Complete to caecum, good preparation. Two sessile polyps (5 mm sigmoid, 7 mm transverse) removed with cold snare, retrieved. Histology: tubular adenomas, low-grade dysplasia, completely excised.

surgicalHistory: Screening colonoscopy with polypectomy (3 weeks ago)

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Two small tubular adenomas completely removed — low-risk findings
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Two tubular adenomas < 10 mm, low-grade dysplasia, completely removed at a complete good-quality colonoscopy: low-risk findings. No early surveillance colonoscopy.

mustInclude.note: BSG 2020: low risk → no colonoscopic surveillance; MSTF 2020: 7–10 years.

mustExclude.note: A 1- or 3-year colonoscopy after low-risk adenomas is over-surveillance.

guideline.name: BSG/ACPGBI/PHE post-polypectomy and post-colorectal cancer resection surveillance guidelines
guideline.section: Low-risk findings (no high-risk criteria): no colonoscopic surveillance — return to population screening when invited; high-risk findings: one-off surveillance at 3 years; large non-pedunculated polyp (≥ 20 mm) removed piecemeal: site-check colonoscopy at 2–6 months
guideline.citation: Rutter MD, East J, Rees CJ, et al. British Society of Gastroenterology/Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland/Public Health England post-polypectomy and post-colorectal cancer resection surveillance guidelines. Gut. 2020;69:201–223.

guideline.name: US Multi-Society Task Force — recommendations for follow-up after colonoscopy and polypectomy
guideline.section: 1–2 tubular adenomas < 10 mm completely removed: repeat colonoscopy in 7–10 years; adenoma ≥ 20 mm removed piecemeal: repeat colonoscopy (site check) at 6 months
guideline.citation: Gupta S, Lieberman D, Anderson JC, et al. Recommendations for follow-up after colonoscopy and polypectomy: a consensus update by the US Multi-Society Task Force on Colorectal Cancer. Gastroenterology. 2020;158:1131–1153.

rationale: Both guidelines de-escalated surveillance after 1–2 small tubular adenomas. Short-interval colonoscopy wastes endoscopy capacity and exposes the patient to procedural risk.
